description: Linear regression of DDR power-component contribution (delta_mW_at_30fps) against DDR Read/Write (MB), fit across all 25 sweep points (sweep_transformer_config.json + ocram_threshold_bisection.json + bev_25_50_gap_fill.json + bev_large_grid_sweep.json). Also includes the readDivDDR power-law fit from ddr_bandwidth_probe.json used to back out the implicit default divisor.

cycle_powerlaw_fit.bandwidth_conversion_caveat: Converting readDivDDR=4.18 bytes/cycle at 2GHz to ~8.4 GB/s assumes the cycle model's internal byte-count unit maps 1:1 onto vnnmap's reported DDR Read (MB) field. A magnitude cross-check (comparing the fitted B constant against actual DDR Read MB for the bev_200 baseline) showed a >10x discrepancy, so this GB/s figure should be treated as approximate, not confirmed.
